access_boundary: This record represents the Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview identified by the model code gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview, released March 3, 2026 and shut down May 25, 2026 with gemini-3.1-flash-lite as its replacement. The GA line, the Flash sibling, the Vertex AI and Gemini app products, and later Gemini releases remain separate model or service boundaries.
strengths: Google documents the release, deprecation, and shutdown dates in the changelog and deprecations table
The model page carries a shutdown banner naming the replacement
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation
The release is shut down and new traffic must migrate to the GA replacement
